strategy.skills: symlink each selected skills/<name> into ~/.agents/skills/<name> (or ./.agents/skills with --project); selection by --pack
strategy.shared: symlink shared/references into <skills folder>/../shared/references (a copy with --copy), in a folder holding the installer's marker, so that a skill's ../../shared/references/<file> resolves

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: run the floor model's eval runs through OpenRouter, and the runtime's model calls through the API adapter when its model is openrouter/<vendor>/<model>
secrets.permission: a key used only for evals and the runtime; a credit limit on it is recommended
secrets.note: in an eval run the value never enters the run container: the key proxy (evals/container/keyproxy/) holds it and adds it to each call, and the run gets a placeholder and the proxy's base URL in OPENROUTER_BASE_URL

secrets.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: run the floor model's eval runs through DeepSeek's own API, when the floor model id is deepseek/<model>
secrets.permission: a key used only for evals; a spending limit on it is recommended
